_note: The far distance, before and after the tone curve. The standing fault out there is aerial perspective: the further a thing is, the more the haze should have taken its colour and lifted it towards the sky. The fifteenth session set that ladder under ACES; this asks what the same pixels are under the Villa's new curve. `aces as it was` reproduces the released v0.10.1 — its curve and its exposure together, since the two are paid for one another. The `float=1` on both cases lifts the eye 90 m for the two high views, where the hills show; it also leaves the standing view 4 cm off the ground it would settle to, which is why its picks are named by mesh and not by distance. From the ground the hills mostly hide: their tops are lower than the tree line's tops, so they show only where the tree line has a gap.
